verdict.rationale: Importing a Figma file or existing design is a fair question for a prompt-to-app builder like Floot, but the evidence pack never mentions Figma import or implementing an imported design. The only nearby item describes pointing at elements or annotating screenshots to direct edits to an existing app. That is an adjacent editing feature, not design import, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can import a Figma file or existing design and have the builder implement it
